name: Omaquest
author: Luiz Felipe - F360c4
description: An offline RPG in the Omarchy bar. Your machine is the realm: workspaces, windows, music, rest and crashes become the hero's chronicle. Fight in the arena, send expeditions, forge gear. Pick a race and a class. No network, no grind, never interrupts.

barWidget.description: Pixel hero in the bar; chronicle, arena, expeditions and forge in the panel.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: Language of the panel. Auto follows the LANG environment variable and falls back to English.

schema.label: Show the hero's level in the bar
schema.description: Adds 'Lv N' beside the sprite on horizontal bars. Vertical bars always show the sprite alone.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: A plucked theme while a fight is on, and a note for a level or a find. Nothing ever plays outside those. Off by default.

schema.label: Notify on level up
schema.description: One desktop notification when the hero reaches a new level. At most two notifications a day in total.

schema.label: Notify when a boss appears
schema.description: A boss appears when a program crashes (systemd coredump) and every weekend. At most two notifications a day in total.

schema.label: Notify when an expedition returns
schema.description: Off by default; the panel already shows the result when you open it.

schema.label: Notify when the daily quests are done
schema.description: Off by default; the panel already shows the Seal when you open it.

schema.label: Arcane sensor: AI agent usage
schema.description: Reads token totals from ~/.local/state/omarchy/agents/usage/. Numbers only, never prompts or answers.

schema.label: Arcane sensor: git commits in ~/Work
schema.description: Counts commits with git rev-list. Never reads messages, file names or repository names.

schema.label: The Bard (AI chronicle, on click only)
schema.description: Adds a button that launches your default Omarchy agent to write today's chronicle. Uses your own agent and your own quota; nothing runs without the click.
